source: Actual Windows Electron 45.2.1 development entry; Sky SendInput keyboard/mouse into Microsoft Chinese Pinyin and native windows, not DOM composition events; PIW_PI_AGENT_DIR unset
entry: pnpm exec node scripts/dev.mjs --desktop using final CI-built artifacts
operations: Selected the sole Pi Workbench window returned by list_windows; unrelated app windows were not controlled
Observed the initial native window: desktop authorized, no project, standalone directory before first send, explicitly selected local SDK fixture, real provider transport disabled

Pressed n/i with real Microsoft Pinyin active and observed its OS candidate panel. Return committed literal ni without sending. A separate n + Space selected Chinese 你 without sending; Return is not claimed to have selected a Chinese candidate
Native Shift+Return inserted a newline. Readonly SQLite before deliberate send remained 0 sessions, 0 submissions, 0 runtimes

Plain Return sent the first task, creating one durable session and one completed submission with OFFLINE_OK. A second native send kept the same sessionId and cwd, producing exactly two completed submissions
Independent existing-session and new-session drafts survived Ctrl+comma settings entry and explicit Return to Workbench navigation. No extra session was created by leaving the unsent draft
Used the unmocked Windows folder picker to select the task-owned empty directory; the daemon validated and displayed its canonical path

Found and fixed same-project newDraft reentry dropping an explicitly selected directory. The extended existing Electron test failed before the fix and passed after it, including an actual page.reload check. Full offline CI passed again before final native validation
On the final implementation, switched from the explicit-directory draft to the existing session and back: both text and directory remained. Settings return also preserved both

Dragged the actual native bottom-right window border to the minimum-width region; screenshot size 802x722. Settings and conversation remained usable in both light and dark, and native caption colors followed the app theme

Sent the explicit-directory new draft through the native UI; OFFLINE_OK completed. Readonly SQLite/JSONL confirmed its stored cwd equals the chosen directory and total 2 sessions / 3 completed submissions / 3 completed turns
Clicked the native maximize control and observed final 1920x1032 work-area layout after animation completed
Exited both validation instances through File > Exit Application; launchers exited 0. Checked product and test ports: no active bindings/connections remained
limitations: Native IME validation used keyboard automation into the real OS input method; it is distinct from both synthetic DOM composition tests and a human typing walkthrough
Ctrl+R is not a registered reload shortcut in this application and did not establish a native reload. Actual reload/draft/request reconciliation is covered by Electron E2E page.reload
Windows system theme settings were not changed; OS theme signal handling remains covered by the existing Electron automated test
No real provider authorization or network model call; no production tools, extensions or web standalone sending enabled

Prior clean reproducibility evidence predates the two-file directory fix and is reused for unchanged dependencies, native modules and build/service infrastructure; final implementation has a fresh complete offline CI
automatedCoverage: pnpm fix and complete pnpm run ci exited 0 after the directory fix: 164 Vitest and 40 browser/Electron E2E, SDK local fixture smoke. Session-specific 9 service integration and 5 Electron tests; count unchanged by extending the existing regression.
